reason: The three reference-internal exports (IsFaultEnabled_Func, SetConfigOption, SetInjectedFault) are declared in no public header and their signatures are unknown; they are not exported until investigated. A consumer that imports them fails at load time instead of calling a guessed signature.

Only implemented transports are listed: hotadd:nbdssl:nbd, the reference's order without file and san (D-0039). file (hosted disks) is not planned and san is unsupported by design (CONTRACT.md section 122).
A NULL-parameter (local, hosted-disk) connection succeeds in the reference; local VMDK access is not implemented, so VIX_E_NOT_SUPPORTED is returned.
Zeroed parameters select a local connection, where the reference ignores the transport list and succeeds; local connections are not implemented.
The reference dereferences a NULL output pointer and faults (SIGSEGV); VIX_E_INVALID_ARG is returned instead.
The reference dereferences an arbitrary handle value and faults (SIGSEGV); handles here are validated by registry lookup and VIX_E_INVALID_HANDLE is returned.
